description: This file defines a generic concurrent object pool implementation in C#, including specific pooling policies for thread-safe object reuse.

classes.name: ConcurrentObjectPool<T>
classes.description: A specialized concurrent object pool with default pooling policy.

classes.name: ConcurrentObjectPool<T, TPoolPolicy>
classes.description: A generic thread-safe object pool supporting custom pooling policies, maintaining per-thread object stacks.

methods.name: ConcurrentObjectPool()
methods.description: Constructor initializing base pool with default policy.

methods.name: ConcurrentObjectPool(TPoolPolicy policy)
methods.description: Constructor accepting a custom pooling policy.

methods.name: Get()
methods.description: Retrieves an object from the pool or creates a new one if none are available.

methods.name: Return(T obj)
methods.description: Returns an object to the pool if the policy permits and the pool is not full.
